title.narrative: Strengthening Young Citizens in Sudan through Democratic Education

description.narrative: Overall Objective: Increased youth participation in the elections contributes to legitimizing and consolidating the Sudanese democracy.Specific Objectives: SO1: The capacity of first-time voters in the age of 19 - 21 at 5 selected universities has been strengthened and their knowledge about the issues at stake in the electoral process has increasedSO2: Awareness on the concerns and expectations as well as political participation of first-time voters in Sudan has been raised among political decision-makers.
